legacy_root.answer: GC deletes a blob only when the index/lockfile scan and an independently written deploy-provenance walk both report zero references. Dry-run lists every candidate with both proofs and writes nothing. Execute requires a matching owner token. A lockfile-only reference keeps the blob. A reviewer-planted provenance-only reference is missed by the index scan, caught by the second walk, and kept. SUCCESS:IMP-0125
